coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: DODO 多鐸, Apr. 2, 1614–1649, Apr. 29, the first Prince Yü (Yü Ch'in-wang 豫親王), known in his day as Shih Wang 十王, was the fifteenth son of Nurhaci [q. v.] and commander of the Bordered White Banner.
